Uses of Class
jaba.convexHull3d.HullFace

Packages that use HullFace
Package
Description
jaba
The JABA tool: identification of bottlenecks in multiclass closed product form networks using efficient convex hull algorithms, as described in the user manual.
jaba.convexHull3d
Three dimensional convex hull algorithms used by JABA for models with three customer classes.
jaba.graphs
Graphical components of JABA: two and three dimensional graphs of the saturation sectors and of the convex hull of the model.
